notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/500d72e3fff5a0a174a5dd2daf19e460a5b51afe.png[/img]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i][/h3]
[b]Happy New Year! Let's start the year with an amazing event from Toge Productions.[/b]

[i]Kicking off 2025 with excitement, we are bringing you the 16th Toge Productions Anniversary Event! Don’t miss out on amazing deals and the latest game updates![/i]

[h3]Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event is underway![/h3] 
Toge Productions' annual anniversary sale on Steam is here! Discover the latest updates on our upcoming games in development and exciting news on our published titles. It’s the perfect way to hype the year off and what's coming ahead!

[i][b]Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event is happening now until January 24, 2025![/b][/i]
Check out the newly announced games and enjoy discounts of up to 85% on individual titles and bundles. We’re excited to continue bringing enjoyable games for everyone to play. 

[h3]Watch Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Direct here![/h3] [previewyoutube=Lp6GDHcyNqc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]You can learn more about the Toge Productions Anniversary Event here![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/togeproductions/sale/togesale2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5485678/eddf3a9ce36a1473f32fbf994fafb0496ab7b92e.png[/img][/url]

Enjoy amazing discounts on Toge Productions' developed and published titles during the anniversary sale! Enjoy Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly with the newly updated gameplay and branching stories! The cafe is bustling with familiar casts and new regulars looking to share their stories. Tick off your wishlist list that has been waiting for a while when you still can! 

[h3]Toge Productions 16th Anniversary Event. 
Grab the Coffee Talk series—now on sale![/h3]

[h3][b]Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now 30% OFF![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly/

[h3][b]Coffee Talk is now 50% OFF![/b][/h3]
[h3][i]The most favorite coffee brewing, heart to heart talking simulator[/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/

[h3][b]Coffee Talk The Complete Series is 45% OFF![/b][/h3]
[h3][i]The perfect gift in a bundle to start the coffee brewing, heart-to-heart talks.[/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28476/Coffee_Talk_Episode_1__2__Complete_Series/


[h3][b]The Coffee Talk series is expanding with a spin-off.[/b][/h3]
After the release of Coffee Talke Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly, we collaborated with our friends at Chorus Worldwide to work on a new title. The title, Coffee Talk Tokyo, was teased last year and was the fruition of collab. This next project will act as a spin-off in the Coffee Talk series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/0cf2d565b932dbf07b04dfe098934d95a9db7e56.jpg[/img] [b][i]Presenting the new key art for Coffee Talk Tokyo, featuring new stories and characters.[/i][/b]

[h3][b]It's a small cafe behind a skyscraper.[/b][/h3]
[b]Wishlist the game here![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161220/Coffee_Talk_Tokyo/


Looking forward to spreading the coziness with you all in 2025! 
Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more news soon.

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 Workshop Released! Introducing the Characters Mod
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c1ac79cf22364e018c4cd1c235a8dc91a9832093.png[/img]
[h2]Get creative with your favorite Coffee Talk regulars with the [i]Characters Mod[/i][/h2]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]
[b][i]The modding tool for Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now released.[/i][/b]

Have you wondered how your favorite characters in Coffee Talk look in different looks? We are happy to announce that our workshop support for Coffee Talk Episode 2 is now available. Now, you can access the modding tool from inside the game and the already existing localization and voice-over mod from the first title.

[h3]The workshop tool, with the new characters mod, is out now![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/c136232ca7e2e52479c9d35a960672be1b74e20f.gif[/img]

Coming from our previous title, Coffee Talk, we always look out to our fans and let them express their creativity towards our characters. This time, to spice things up a bit, we also include the new characters mod, where you can change your characters looks to your liking. You can check out our new documentation workshop from the link below. 

[h3][url=https://togepresskit.notion.site/Coffee-Talk-Ep-2-Modding-Tutorial-432ad3476b17475689743558fd1256f8]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Workshop Documentation[/url][/h3]
Workshop documentation and guide [url=https://togepresskit.notion.site/Coffee-Talk-Ep-2-Modding-Tutorial-432ad3476b17475689743558fd1256f8]here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/7790ec049e58687dd05ea60060d6a226de987ee8.gif[/img]
Just look at how Lucas seems so cool with a skeleton hoodie and dark sclera. 
[i]Yeah, we didn't intend this to happen. [/i]

[h3]Additional localization added.[/h3]
We are sorry for the delay, but now you can enjoy the additional localization of the Russian language to the game. We always listen to our fans and try to push out more updates. 

If you encounter any bugs or are looking for answers directly from us, please join our Discord community. You can also reach us from our social media to get the latest news of Coffee Talk updates. We will always serve more stuff that you can look forward to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/b04803d97bba2e533ae8ee041af697b669218945.png[/img][url=https://twitter.com/coffeetalk_game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/79dd3f2effac213f7a4d79409aa7b3a3427c939d.png[/img][/url][url=discord.gg/toge][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/8b1312b21a87946f96f4f0f6eaabe151fe9fa95c.png[/img][/url][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33359823/84fedc2164e8a93f749f967a579a4dd488b8b784.png[/img]

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 New Languages Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/455f5f668e1b0d4a24428a3890576f37cea2ef6c.png[/img]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars. [/i][/h3]

Two months had passed since the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly. [b]We are thankful for all the feedback we received so far as we gradually update the game to what our community has voiced.[/b] Currently, we are trying our best to make Coffee Talk Episode 2 available in several different languages, with more coming later this year. 

[h3][b]Now Available in Bahasa Indonesia, Brazilian Portuguese, and Turkish! [/b][/h3]
[b]Enjoy serving coffee & tea of Coffee Talk to your favorite regulars in Bahasa Indonesia, Brazilian Portuguese, and Turkish.[/b] The first significant language update of the Coffee Talk Episode is here! We are releasing three languages simultaneously on Steam and other platforms. We hope that by reading the dialogues and stories of Coffee Talk Episode 2 in your native language, you will feel more familiar with the characters and understand more about the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/3f7451e1d2e9b8314ce03fa1f99a02ccae4c6770.gif[/img]
[b][i]In-game preview of the three new languages available now to play![/i][/b]

[h3][b]Languages Update Sale![/b][/h3]
Grab Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly on its first sale now 20% OFF! Take a copy for yourself or give them to your friend who you think would love to enjoy it in their native language. It's never too late to start brewing a new chapter with a cup of coffee (or tea if you want to keep it low on caffeine). ːctcoffeeː

[h3][b]Grab Coffee Talk Episode 2 here 20% OFF![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

[b] More updates will come later this year, so keep updated through our social media platforms! [/b] If you have encountered bugs, typos, or technical issues, you can hit us on the Steam discussion or join our community to get a faster response. Please eagerly wait for us to tease more after-release treatment soon.

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/1bccddba5c783b82a2bc9b155250c10554293a6e.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]

[i][h3]Discover new drinks as you deliver them to the regulars, and expose the piece of the story to their hearts. [/h3][/i]
In that one particular street corner of Seattle, a coffee shop called Coffee Talk opens late at night and continues its business after several years. The regulars have their own routines and still come to the coffee shop as they have more stories to tell. There are even new regulars who come and stay because of the Coffee Talk’s charm. It’s no other than the cozy vibes and the Barista’s magnificent brewing that makes people come back. Moreover, how one regular can unexpectedly encounter other distinctive regulars with their own tales to chat about. 

[i][b]Every drink you serve will tell a different story as you give them to different people. It’s up to you as the Barista to listen to their problems and hopefully can solve their problems.[/b][/i]

[i]Check out the release trailer here.[/i]
[previewyoutube=q4s5M28J1gU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is a standalone title, a sequel to the original Coffee Talk game. The second episode will feature new characters, new stories to tell, and new mechanics to treat with.[/b] In a time where people are isolated from each other, attending to their busy lives, Coffee Talk is a place where everyone can reconnect over a cup of warm drink. Relax and enjoy the much-loved coffee brewing, heart-to-heart simulator, by serving the regulars, old and new, that will resonate with you. Indulge yourself with even more hand-drawn pixelated art of Coffee Talk and new drinks you have never seen before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/ac4e06e68ea27da0a7212cc709dedbbdb7bd853f.gif[/img]

Thank you for staying with us all these years to the point we are right now. The positive and continuous support from our community is what makes us keep going to make better games. At first, we didn’t believe we would make another episode of Coffee Talk and move forward to a different project. However, the community feedback and warm response is what pushed us to bring more content that you will enjoy. We wish you a pleasant experience playing the game as we intended it to be. 

[i]Revisit the Coffee Talk a few years later, where everyone has more different stories to tell. Serve warm drinks and immerse yourself once again in the relaxing atmosphere of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly.[/i]

[h3][b]Coffee Talk Episode 2 is OUT NOW. Grab the game here![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

[b]Follow us on social media and join our community to get the latest news and updates about the game after its release.[/b] We are excited to see your response about the game in the community please don’t hesitate to join us! Share your love for Coffee Talk, as we also will keep you updated for more news.

[h2]Good evening, fellow Cafe Regulars.[/h2]

How have you been? 
We hope you’re doing safe and sound in the midst of the pandemic, staying cozy and all. We here at the studio are working hard to grow new games you enjoy.

[h3]At last, we are extremely excited to announce the second episode of Coffee Talk![/h3]

Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly for the very first time, will be shown in [b]The Indie Houses[/b] event! The Indie Houses is an international collective of indie games publishers where Toge Productions is part of this awesome collective. There will be lots of other wonderful indie games featured in this event.

The Indie Houses event will be happening on Steam from August 31st 2021 until September 7th 2021. Be sure to come and check it out. 

Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly will be live with a pre-recorded broadcast on [b]September 1st, from 7 pm PT until 8 pm PT. [/b]
